issues.description: The problem statement refers to the internet address field as 'url' (lowercase), while the solution SQL aliases the column as 'Url' (capitalized). The template query also omits the url column entirely. The difference in identifier casing (and the template omission) can create minor mapping confusion for students who look for a column named exactly 'url' as described in the task.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent: either change the solution alias to 'url' (lowercase) and include Zoo.url in the template SELECT, or update the problem statement to refer to 'Url' to match the solution. Prefer using 'url' lowercase to match the field name shown in the schema description.
